messages.text: Hello, you refunded my kettle last week, thank you, but I also paid 18 reais shipping for a kettle that arrived broken. I want the shipping refunded.
Shipping charges aren’t refunded automatically, but a staff member can review your request (refund-policy/v2/shipping). Would you like a staff member to review the shipping charge?
